description: Registry of Mendix apps and branches the ACM-Writer agent has worked on. Maps each app to its on-disk working copy so the parser can be driven without re-sending paths. Maintained by ACM/AI-tools/ACM-Writer.md.

fieldDocs.name: Human-readable app name. Unique key. Apps are sorted by this field.
fieldDocs.storyPrefixes: Ticket prefixes used for this app (e.g. SH-2086 -> prefix SH). Used to infer the app from a story id.
fieldDocs.projectPath: Absolute path to the git working copy folder that contains the .mpr. Passed to the parser as projectPath. null until recorded.
fieldDocs.mprPath: Absolute path to the .mpr file (informational; the parser finds the top-level *.mpr inside projectPath). null until recorded.
fieldDocs.mendixVersion: Studio Pro version the app needs, from mx show-version. null until recorded.
fieldDocs.mendixInstallRoot: Override for the Mendix install root if not the default. null = use defaults.mendixInstallRoot.
fieldDocs.branches: Branches worked on. Each: { name, signature, lastUsed (yyyy-MM-dd), projectPath (optional, if the branch has its own working copy) }.
fieldDocs.knownStoryIds: Story ids seen in mendix-data/Commit messages for this app. Informational.
